root_cause.statement: The ordinary competent Baseline already made the same perimeter-scoped, no-conversion-credit treatment as Enhanced. V4 added descriptive explicitness but no actual material pre-outcome economic treatment difference.

economic_retention: The result is useful design evidence: the narrow V4 rule is compatible with ordinary judgment-first behavior but has not been shown to create incremental handling. It is neither a V4 failure nor evidence of method utility; FY2024 cannot distinguish two equivalent treatments.
next_action: Do not repeat the same prompt-only V4 pair merely to obtain an outcome. Design the next evaluation as a real learning-memory intervention: Enhanced receives a bounded, mechanism-relevant teaching retrieval package while Baseline receives no such worked-case retrieval, with outcome isolation and identical company-evidence/tools/budget preserved.
